title: From Magnetic to Inverse Magnetic Catalysis: The Interplay of Quark and Gluon Mass Generation in Magnetic Fields
summary: We analyze the effects of the magnetic field on the quark and gluon propagators within the functional QCD framework. By solving the coupled Dyson-Schwinger equations for the quark and gluon propagators, we find that the quark mass is generally enhanced in the presence of a magnetic field, leading to magnetic catalysis of the chiral condensate. Meanwhile, the magnetic field also induces an increase in the gluon screening mass.
